notes: All timings are synchronized wall time, not GPU kernel timestamps.
First generated token belongs to prefill, decode has N-1 tokens.
AR has no hidden feature hooks; draft weights remain resident for paired runs.
Phases serialize draft/verify/rollback; detail adds per-module barriers.
Fine profiles are diagnostic and not production throughput.
Only fixed-budget greedy sampling; EOS ignored; output text decoding excluded.

backend.wired_memory_policy: official mlx_lm.generate.wired_limit, outside phase timers; restored on exit
backend.kv_quantization_scope: attention caches only; recurrent state unchanged
backend.peak_memory_unit: decimal GB, MLX allocator peak per request
backend.draft_quantization_strategy: runtime mlx.nn.quantize affine, group_size=64, before binding shared target embedding/head; original downloaded weights preserved
backend.acceptance_accounting: all verified matching drafts, including non-emitted final proposals; exact rollback observer; target bonus excluded
backend.greedy_parity: must be independently validated against same-environment MLXBackend

methodology.time_kind: synchronized wall-clock milliseconds, not GPU-only kernel time
methodology.block: K input positions; production GDN capture; target forward, hidden concatenation, argmax, cache evaluation and host token transfer
methodology.sequential: K completed one-token forwards; ordinary GDN; argmax, cache evaluation and host token transfer per step; hidden hooks remain but no concatenation
methodology.cache: Each branch clones the same complete prefix cache, preserving allocated capacity and metadata; snapshots checked unchanged
methodology.interpretation: Teacher-forced batching ceiling on an actual continuation; real benefit must cover drafting plus rollback and use accepted+1 useful tokens, not all K positions
methodology.warmup: One block and one sequential trial per width, excluded from results
methodology.order: Block/sequential then sequential/block, alternating per repeat
